code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and increased monocytes and basophils. Red cell distribution width is elevated, suggesting anisocytosis. Total protein is slightly low, while albumin is mildly elevated. Electrolytes, renal, and liver function are within normal limits. Findings may indicate an underlying infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
